title: Counting in Vieta graphs over $\mathbb{F}_p$
summary: We introduce and study a finite simple graph of algebraic origin: the Vieta graph on the solution set over $\mathbb{F}_p$ to a symmetric, multivariate equation which is quadratic in each variable. This construction is a broad generalization of the Markoff graph over $\mathbb{F}_p$, extensively studied in the recent literature. We give a systematic approach, partly based on quadratic character sums, to the following basic counting questions: how many vertices does a Vieta graph have, and what is the degree distribution?
